pages.title: About
pages.body:
Everybody has a shift.

Early starts. Night shifts. Twelve hours on your feet. Forty at a desk, counting down to Friday. However yours goes, you put in the hours.

The good part is what happens after.

A line in the water. The back nine on a Tuesday. Cornhole boards in the driveway. The cottage, finally.

OFF SHFT makes the hat you wear when you get there.

Days off don’t always fall on a weekend. Plenty of people get a Tuesday and a Wednesday. These hats don’t mind which.

The logo is an O with clock hands at 5:00. Quitting time.

We keep the designs small and quiet, with plenty of empty fabric. Every hat is made to order and shipped to you.

You put in the hours. This time is yours.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.body:
Is OFF SHFT a typo?

No. It's spelled that way on purpose. You put in the hours. This time is yours.

How long until I get it?

About 1–2 weeks, sometimes longer. Everything's made to order, which usually takes 2–5 business days, and shipping is about 3–5 more. If you order a few things, they can come in separate boxes.

How much is shipping?

Standard shipping is C$12 an order and free on orders of C$75 or more. We ship to Canada and the US. Prices are in Canadian dollars, even for US orders.

Will I have to pay duties?

You might. Prices and shipping don't include duties or import fees. Your order could ship from another country, and we can't tell ahead of time. If it does, the carrier may charge them when it arrives.

What size should I get?

Hats are one size, and caps adjust at the back. For everything else, check the charts on Size & fit or ask us.

Can I return or exchange it?

Not if you change your mind or it doesn't fit. It's made for your order, so there's no shelf to put it back on.

What if it's damaged, made wrong or not what I ordered?

Message us your order number within 14 days of delivery. We'll ask for a photo, then replace it or refund you. No need to send it back.

What if it never shows up?

If it hasn't arrived 15 business days after it ships, let us know. If it's lost, we'll replace it or refund you.

Can I change or cancel my order?

Only before we start making it, and we can't always catch it in time. Message us your order number as soon as you can.

How do I wash it?

Hats: hand wash or spot clean in cold water with mild soap. A washing machine can bend them out of shape.

Clothes: wash cold and inside out with like colours, then hang to dry. Wash sweatpants on their own before you first wear them. A little dye can rub off.

No bleach on any of it.

pages.title: Shipping & returns
pages.body:
Shipping

Everything's made to order, which usually takes 2–5 business days, and shipping is about 3–5 more. All in, that's about 1–2 weeks, sometimes longer.

We ship to Canada and the US. Standard shipping is C$12 an order and free on orders of C$75 or more. Prices are in Canadian dollars, even for US orders.

Duties and import fees

Prices and shipping don't include duties or import fees. Your order might ship from another country, and we can't tell ahead of time. If it does, the carrier may charge them when it arrives.

Changes and cancellations

To change or cancel, message us your order number as soon as you can. Once we've started making it, it's too late, and we can't always catch it in time.

Returns

We can't do returns or exchanges if you change your mind or it doesn't fit. It's made for your order, so there's no shelf to put it back on. Check Size & fit before you order.

Garment-dyed colours can be a shade off the photo.

If something's wrong

If anything shows up damaged, made wrong or not what you ordered, that's on us. Message us your order number within 14 days of delivery. We'll ask for a photo, then replace it or refund you. No need to send it back. You've got better things to do with your time.

If your order hasn't arrived 15 business days after it ships, let us know. If it's lost, we'll replace it or refund you.

pages.title: Size & fit
pages.body:
Hats

Every hat is one size. Caps adjust at the back: the Retro Trucker and 5-Panel are firm up front, and the Rope Cap is softer. All three have a snap. The Dad Hat is soft and sits low, with a strap and buckle. Beanies and bucket hats don't adjust.

Clothes

Sizes are unisex. Measure something you own that fits the way you like. Take your time with the tape.

  • Lay it flat and smooth it out.
  • Chest: straight across, armpit to armpit.
  • Length: from where the shoulder meets the collar down to the hem.
  • Sweatpants waist: straight across the waistband, without stretching it.
  • Inseam: from the crotch seam down to the hem.

Find the closest match in the charts below. They're measured the same way, but any piece can be up to 5 cm (2 in) off.

Stuck between two sizes? Send us your measurements and we'll help you pick.

No chart yet for the quarter-zips and golf shirts. Ask us and we'll check the measurements for you.
